description: Deliberate differences between the app and the deployed CBE tool. A parity test passes a difference listed here, fails on any other, and fails on an entry that no longer holds. Only the maintainer adds or removes an entry. See README.md.

divergences.reason: The app corrects the clothing insulation by ISO 7730's rule at every metabolic rate; the deployed tool does not correct it. At the page's defaults the app shows a PMV of -0.41 where the deployed tool shows -0.24.
